question: What qualification must a recipient meet before a particular teaching may be given to one who has previously accomplished it?
premises: The teaching is only to be given under qualification.
The recipient must be one previously accomplished.
That recipient must have been tested for one year.
inference: Only a previously accomplished person tested for one year is fit to receive this teaching.
uncertainties: Nature of the test remains unspecified
plain_english: This teaching is to be given only to one who has previously accomplished it and has been tested for one year.
